card.title: Breaks and holds
card.subtitle: Stop reminders for a while, or pause an enrolment.
card.noCourses: This learner has no current course, so there is nothing to hold or pause.
card.allTaken: Every course already has a break.
card.offNotice: Breaks and holds are switched off for new breaks. This one continues until it ends, and you can still end it here.

form.title: Add a break
form.holdHint: Stays enrolled and keeps paying. Only reminders stop.
form.pauseHint: Stops for a while: no charges or expiry, and the dates move forward on return.
form.stopClassHint: No class reminders by message. They can still join classes from the app.
form.stopFeeHint: No payment, due-date or renewal reminders.
form.removeAccess: Switch the course off while paused
form.removeAccessHint: Hides the course and its recordings until they return.

errors.endRequired: Choose the last day, or pick “No end date”.
errors.endBeforeStart: The last day must be on or after the first day.
errors.nothingToStop: Choose at least one kind of reminder to stop.
errors.endBeforeMin: The last day cannot be before {{date}}.

form.previewFailed: Could not work out what will happen.

preview.title: What will happen
preview.classStops: Class reminders stop. They can still join any class.
preview.feeRestarts: Fee and renewal reminders start again.
preview.accessOff: The course is switched off until they return.
preview.accessBack: The course is switched back on.
preview.accessStays: They keep access to the course and recordings.
preview.billingStops: No charges, renewals or expiry while paused.
preview.endMovesOnReturn: On return, the membership end moves:
preview.instalmentsMove_one: {{count}} unpaid instalment moves by the same days.
preview.instalmentsMove_other: {{count}} unpaid instalments move by the same days.
preview.datesUnchanged: Membership dates stay as they are.

when.todayOpen: Starts today, with no end date.

warnings.NO_MEMBERSHIP: This course has no membership, so only access and reminders are paused.
warnings.PLAN_NOT_ACTIVE: This membership is not active, so there is no billing to pause.
warnings.AUTOPAY_ON: Autopay is on. No charge is taken while paused; the next charge moves with the dates.
warnings.INSTALMENTS_MOVE_ON_RESUME: Unpaid instalments can be moved by the paused days when you resume.
warnings.OPEN_ENDED: No last day: the dates move by however long the pause lasts.
warnings.DUES_STILL_DUE: Dues stay due on their dates; only the reminders stop.

blockers.COURSE_NOT_FOUND: The learner is not enrolled in that course.
blockers.NO_COURSES: The learner has no current course.
blockers.NOTHING_TO_STOP: Choose at least one kind of reminder to stop.
blockers.START_IN_PAST: The first day cannot be in the past.
blockers.END_BEFORE_START: The last day must be on or after the first day.
blockers.TOO_LONG: A break can last at most a year.
blockers.OVERLAP: The learner already has a break on these dates for this course.
blockers.NEW_DATE_NOT_FUTURE: The new end date must be in the future.

SHIFT_BY_PAUSED_DAYS.title_one: Move dates forward by the {{count}} paused day (recommended)
SHIFT_BY_PAUSED_DAYS.title_other: Move dates forward by the {{count}} paused days (recommended)
SHIFT_BY_PAUSED_DAYS.hint: The learner gets back the time they were away.

KEEP_DATES.title: Keep the current dates
KEEP_DATES.hint: Nothing moves; the time away is not given back.

NEW_DATE.title: Set a new end date
NEW_DATE.hint: The membership runs until the date you choose, and the next payment moves to that date.

resume.newDatePick: Choose a date to see what changes.

cancel.title: Cancel this break?
cancel.description: It was due to start on {{date}}. Nothing has changed yet, so nothing needs undoing.
